newsitem.title: CHINA: China's mini-car market seen expanding.
newsitem.headline: China's mini-car market seen expanding.

text.p: China's mini-car market will continue to expand in the next five years and annual demand by the year 2000 will be as many as 800,000, the China Business Times said on Thursday.
Mini-cars would be widely used in China as family cars, taxi, or as pick-ups in the service industry and in township enterprises because of their low prices, it said.

Western and Japanese car makers have long dreamt of building a family car for China's burgeoning middle class, but Beijing has yet to give approval for any joint venture to produce the small and cheap models most likely to sell well.
